test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man alone can do a piece of work in 16 days, but with the help of his friend, he can do it in 8 days. In what time can his friend do it alone?
solution:
**Given:**

A man can complete the work in = 16 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the friend alone can complete the work in X days

A man's one-day work = {1over 16}

Friend's one day work = {1over X}

According to the question

⇒ {1over 16}+{1over X}={1over8}

⇒ {1over X}={1over 8}-{1over 16}

⇒ {1over X}={2-1over 16}

⇒ X = 16 days

The friend alone can complete the work in = 16 days

**∴ The required result will be 16 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__Their ratio of efficiency when they worked together and man's efficiency = 16 : 8 = 2 : 1

The efficiency of friend = 2 - 1 = 1 

The efficiency of a friend is equal to the efficiency of a man then friend also can complete the work in 16 days

∴ The required result will be 16 days.
